summary: Backend-only verification of the MCP tool `bulk_rename_categories` payload fix. New suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter31_bulk_rename_mcp.py — 5 tests, 5 passed (100%). Confirmed: (1) POST /api/restaurants/{rid}/categories/bulk-rename accepts a bare JSON array [{id,name}] and returns 200 {updated:1, skipped:0}; (2) the old buggy MCP shape {'renames': {...}} still returns 422 (contract documented); (3) invalid entries (unknown id, blank name) return 200 {updated:0, skipped:2}; (4) MCP source no longer contains '"renames": mapping' and posts json_body=renames; (5) end-to-end via fastmcp in-memory Client: select_restaurant -> bulk_rename_categories(mapping with 2 category ids) -> 200 {updated:2, skipped:0}, and GET /categories returns both new names. Original names were restored through the MCP tool itself and re-verified via GET (768fe425... = 'Завтраки до 16.00', 59d4cc5a... = 'Завтраки до 16.00 — Добавки к завтракам'), is_active untouched, no _id leakage. Bug is FIXED.

minor.issue: Translation reset hardcodes only name_en/name_zh ($set to ""), while background re-translation uses restaurant.enabled_languages. For a restaurant with other langs enabled (e.g. de/ar), the stale name_<lang> is NOT cleared -> outdated translation stays visible; conversely name_zh is wiped even when 'zh' is not enabled and is therefore never regenerated. Suggest clearing/regenerating exactly the enabled_languages set.

Unknown restaurant_id (e.g. fake-rid-99999) returns 200 {updated:0, skipped:N} for superadmin instead of 404 — check_restaurant_access does not verify restaurant existence (observed in backend logs from prior iterations; low severity, no data impact).

critical_code_review_comments: mcp_server/restmenu_mcp/server.py bulk_rename_categories now matches the backend contract (top-level array). Remaining contract-drift risk elsewhere: worth a one-time audit of every MCP tool body vs its FastAPI signature (list vs model vs dict) since two such mismatches were already found.
bulk-rename should derive the set of translation fields to reset from restaurant.enabled_languages instead of the hardcoded name_en/name_zh pair.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing restaurant aa25189d-d668-4838-915a-c5d936547f3f and its first two categories; temporary names TEST_MCP_0/TEST_MCP_1 were reverted and original names asserted in module teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two reusable MCP suites now exist: test_iter30_category_toggle_mcp.py (update_category is_active) and test_iter31_bulk_rename_mcp.py (bulk_rename_categories). Both drive real MCP tools in-process via sys.path.insert('/app/mcp_server') + fastmcp.Client(mcp_server.mcp) against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Category names/is_active for aa25189d-... are restored; do not leave TEST_ prefixes behind. Note bulk-rename wipes name_en/name_zh and enqueues background translation, so translated fields may lag a few seconds after a rename.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous bug: MCP tool posted {'renames': {id: name}} while the route signature is `renames: List[dict]`, so FastAPI/Pydantic rejected the object body with 422 'Input should be a valid list'. Fix converts the mapping into [{'id': k, 'name': v}] and sends it as the top-level array — verified end-to-end (200, updated:2, skipped:0, names persisted, then restored).
